newsitem.title: CANADA: Stone-Consolidated says buys mill stake.
newsitem.headline: Stone-Consolidated says buys mill stake.

text.p: Stone-Consolidated Corp said on Tuesday it entered into a deal to acquire a 75 percent stake in Produits Forestiers La Tuque, a sawmill located in Site Vallieres, near La Tuque, Quebec.
The mill has an annual capacity of 50 million feet board measure (fbm) and provided sawlogs harvested on a 240,000 cubic meter government contract.
Under the deal, the mill would provide chips to Stone-Consolidated's paper mills when current chip contracts expired, the company said.
The 75 percent holding was originally held by Marcel Benoit, Stone-Consolidated said. The remaining 25 percent is owned by La Cooperative forestiere du Haute Saint-Maurice.
